The global hotel pipeline

How we built this list

Every project on this page is from our live database of new and under-construction developments worldwide. We add a project only after we can confirm it from a public filing, an official announcement, or independent reporting; status changes (breaking ground, topping out, opening) are sourced the same way and timestamped. Pro members get full access to TMW Intelligence’s prediction modeling, Atlas data compilation, Pulse notifications, personalized notifications, comparison view, watchlists, and more.

Common questions

Frequently asked

Which cities have the most new hotels?
The deepest hotels pipelines are in Nashville (18), Riyadh (16), Miami (15), Tokyo (11), Dubai (11). We track 422 hotels projects total across 208 cities.
How many new hotels are under construction worldwide?
171 hotels are currently under construction worldwide. Plus 17 breaking ground, 56 opening soon, and 103 announced in the global pipeline.
What new hotels are opening soon worldwide?
56 hotels are flagged Opening Soon — meaning expected opening within ~7 months. Browse each individually in the pipeline grid above.
What hotels have just been announced for 2026?
103 hotels are in the announced phase across our global dataset. Each links to a live status page that updates as construction begins.
What is the tallest new hotel in the global pipeline?
Jeddah Tower in Jeddah at 157 floors. See the project →
Who is the most active developer in hotels worldwide?
Aman Group leads the hotels category with 10 active projects. Their firm page shows every market they're building in.
Who designs the most new hotels?
Arquitectonica is the architect of record on 15 hotels projects in our global dataset.
How many total residential units are coming online in new hotels?
Across the active global hotels pipeline, the developments we track will add 221,473 residential units.
When will the next wave of new hotels deliver?
Delivery dates across the active global pipeline run from 2025 through 2046. Pro members get the TMW Forecast on every project as dates move.
How often is the hotels development data updated?
Hourly. Our cron pipeline pulls fresh project data every hour and regenerates every market page. A status change confirmed today shows up within ~60 minutes.
